correctness.rationale: The row-major and column-major intersection orders commute precisely for consistent pairwise block orders; a common refinement supports independent nonempty cut subsets at its m-1 gaps. Given abelian group colors, r initial labels have product c1 in g^(r-1) ways and each gap involving s freshly cut factors has g^(s-1) solutions to the next output-color equation. This proves the multivariate formula and Stirling-sum EGF; an independently coded direct enumeration of all commuting tuple fibers verifies finite cases for cyclic groups and C2xC2.

value.rationale: A complete product-fiber law with all individual factor block statistics is a natural monoid multiplication invariant; all arities and every finite abelian coloring group are covered, with a nonobvious dependence only on group order. The concrete fixed-product and group-isomorphism invariance extend substantially beyond the known uncolored pair total. The result is motivated by extensions of face semigroups used in wreath-product descent theory, not an arbitrary finite-size slice.
